title: presence.py: Negative age_s when time goes backwards
description: Line 208: `int(now - entry["updated_at"])` produces negative age values if time_source() returns a time earlier than the stored updated_at timestamp (e.g., after NTP clock adjustment). The field name `age_s` implies non-negative duration, but clients could receive values like `{"age_s": -50}`. Fix: use `max(0, int(now - entry["updated_at"]))` or similar.
notes: Bug already fixed: age_s_at() at python/src/lichen/presence.py:119-123 already clamps negative values to 0 via max(0, int(now_f - ts_f)). The function is used at coap/resources/presence.py:258 for age_s calculation. Test verification: age_s_at(100, 200) returns 0 (not -100).
